summary: Spec fidelity (checker.md section 2 one owner per pass condition; section 4/6: 'schema writing anything is a MUST failure of L1.no-state', skills show nothing written is L2.skills's): L2.effects runs every successful read command of the fixture except schema (effects_plan.rs:79), so a skills show that the fixture lists under commands.ok and that writes a file is failed by L2.skills ('nothing written', measured in an empty directory) and again by L2.effects (read-changes-only-allowed). Probe on the conforming L2 fake with skills show listed and skillsPutsFile set both in the config and the executable name (the empty-state runs do not see the fixture env, which is why the implementer's case uses the alias): L2.skills fail and L2.effects fail for the one write. atip.checkl2guides.02 does not list skills show in the fixture, so it cannot see the second owner. Blast radius: any tool that lists skills show; fix is the same exclusion schema has.
